title: Amphitrite Point Lighthouse
visualBrief: Low broad white concrete lighthouse/service building on its complete native D-shaped footprint: gently battered lower wall, setback flat-roof upper storey with a small physical vent, short red hexagonal glazed lantern and hipped roof/weather mast, and recessed landward door with intrinsic short approach steps/handrails. Detached station, helipads, fence, trail and rocky landscape excluded.
